summary: Tested this session's 4 features end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass (/api/teams/defaults 3 presets x 6 roles with correct providers + uncensored flags; /api/teams/reset for all 3 teams incl. persistence via GET /api/settings, 400 on unknown team, 422 on missing session_id, and confirmed reset does NOT clobber BYOK keys/github; /api/settings now returns all 6 roles and round-trips 6-role saves; /api/tier/topup/packages returns exactly 8/16/32 -> 500/1000/2000 credits; /api/tier/topup/checkout returns clean 401 'sign in required' for all 3 packages and for bad/empty package, never 500; /api/profile returns 401 unauthenticated, with anon X-Capcode-Session, and with a bogus bearer). Frontend: app boots with zero page errors after dead-code cleanup, default-teams-section renders 3 team buttons, nvidia/openrouter apply immediately with correct sonner toast and update all 6 role tabs, venice opens the consent modal first — cancel leaves assignments unchanged, 'i agree' closes the modal and applies the Venice team; assignments persist across settings close/reopen and full page reload. 'profile' button correctly does NOT render for anonymous visitors (only 'sign in with google'). Real signed-in flows (profile contents, topup checkout mock credit) not testable — no non-Google auth path, per instructions.

ui_bugs.issue: The 6 role tabs are visually collapsed to a ~5px sliver on the default settings view. Measured: the tab row container height = 5.01px while each role-tab child is 24px tall and overflows out of it, so the TEACHER/ARCHITECT/ARTIST/REVIEWER/RATER/CORRECTOR labels + current model are unreadable (see screenshot: thin band between the DEFAULT TEAMS block and the search input). They only render at full height once the model list is short (e.g. after the 'uncensored only' filter cuts 278 -> 6 rows). RCA: the modal is `panel max-h-[95vh] flex flex-col` (SettingsPanel.jsx:182) and the role-tab row (line 265: `flex border-b border-phosphor/30 overflow-x-auto`) has no `shrink-0`, so with the new DEFAULT TEAMS section added above it the row is flex-shrunk to nothing. Fix: add `shrink-0` to the role-tab row (and the header/billing/teams/filters/keys sections) and keep only `[data-testid="model-list"]` as the `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto` region. Tabs are still clickable (clicking role-tab-corrector correctly switched the footer to 'CORRECTOR :: openrouter / anthropic/claude-sonnet-5'), so this is layout-only but it hides the primary readout of the new 6-role feature.

integration_issues.flow: Venice team apply via consent modal
integration_issues.issue: Agreeing to the Venice waiver from a team-reset click also force-enables the unrelated 'uncensored only' model-list filter (setUncensoredOnly(true) in the shared onAgree handler, SettingsPanel.jsx:508), so the catalog silently drops from 278 to 6 models. Harmless but surprising as a side effect of a team preset; consider only setting the filter when the consent came from the toggle itself.

action_items: Add `shrink-0` to the SettingsPanel role-tab row (and sibling fixed sections) + `flex-1 min-h-0` on the model list so the 6 role tabs are not squashed to 5px.
Optional: don't flip the 'uncensored only' catalog filter when the Venice consent is granted from a team-reset click.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/teams/reset trusts an arbitrary caller-supplied session_id in the body (not the X-Capcode-Session header), so anyone who learns another browser's session UUID can overwrite that device's model assignments. Consider deriving the session from the header like the other ownership-scoped endpoints.
No stale references to the deleted /app/api/index.py or root requirements.txt anywhere in the repo; vercel.json keeps only the /neon-auth rewrite. Backend + frontend boot clean.
SettingsPanel.jsx is 530 lines and now owns billing, teams, roles, catalog, BYOK and GitHub state — consider splitting the DEFAULT TEAMS block into its own component.

rca_of_the_issue: Role-tab collapse: SettingsPanel's modal body is a fixed-height flex column (max-h-[95vh] flex flex-col); the newly added DEFAULT TEAMS section increased total content height, and because the role-tab row lacks shrink-0 the flexbox shrinks it to ~5px while its 24px children overflow, making the 6 role tabs visually unreadable (still clickable). Reproduce: open app -> Start building -> model settings -> inspect the strip below '[ DEFAULT TEAMS :: RESET ALL 6 ROLES ]' (or tick 'uncensored only' to see the tabs pop back to full height).
